motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that Council DIRECTS the General Services Department (GSD) to report on how they prioritize building maintenance requests from departments and the timeline for completing the work. They should also include recommendations for improving the turnaround time for work orders, and further utilization of contracted vendors for certain services.
